profile.primaryRole: Senior digital transformation & product leader (Healthcare / Life Sciences) — targeting Director / Senior Director / Principal / VP / Group PM roles (NOT C-suite)
profile.summary: Geetanjali Arora is a seasoned technology and product executive with 17+ years of experience integrating healthcare IT and digital transformation, spanning pharma (Pfizer), diagnostics (Bio Reference Laboratories), and specialty EHR (SRS Health/Nextech). She brings deep expertise in building and scaling SaaS product portfolios, leading agile transformations, managing multi-million-dollar programs, and driving measurable revenue and efficiency outcomes. Most recently operating at the Principal/Senior Director level, she is well-positioned for VP or C-suite roles in healthtech, digital health, or enterprise SaaS.
certifications: change acceleration process for leaders (ge cap)
